mentions.name: Snowday Academy
mentions.description: Reading practice and assessment platform for K-12 students that uses speech-to-text and quizzes to assess reading ability, picking up skipped words, substituted words, and metrics on speed and pauses, with reporting and tracking for parents, tutors, and teachers.
mentions.audience: Explicitly aimed at K-12 students, with parents, private tutors, teachers, and the homeschooling community as the reporting/tracking users.
mentions.source_excerpt: Reading practice and assessments for k-12 students, with reporting and tracking for parents, tutors, and teachers. It uses speech to text and quizzes to assess the students reading ability. It picks up skipped words, substituted words, along with metrics on speed and pauses.
